:::{#exm-score-equation}
#### Score equation of a Bernoulli sample

For $n$ independent Bernoulli observations with $r = \sum_i y_i$ successes,
the score is $\sumin (y_i - \prob)/\paren{\prob(1 - \prob)} = (r - n\prob)/\paren{\prob(1-\prob)}$
(summing @exr-derive-bernoulli-score over the observations),
so for $0 < r < n$ the score equation $(r - n\prob)/\paren{\prob(1-\prob)} = 0$
has the single solution $\prob = r/n$.
:::
